jsonld.name: Lana's Kitchen
jsonld.description: Catering business in Jacksonville, FL specialized in weddings and private celebrations.

parrafo.es: Catering de bodas y celebraciones privadas en Jacksonville, FL. Comida casera, bien sazonada y servida con cuidado, para que tus invitados solo piensen en repetir.
parrafo.en: Wedding and private celebration catering in Jacksonville, FL. Homemade food, well seasoned and served with care, so your guests only think about going back for seconds.

parrafo_1.es: Lana's Kitchen es un catering de Jacksonville, FL especializado en bodas y celebraciones privadas. Varias familias repiten con ellos año tras año, para bodas, fiestas pequeñas y reuniones familiares.
parrafo_1.en: Lana's Kitchen is a Jacksonville, FL catering business specialized in weddings and private celebrations. Several families keep coming back year after year, for weddings, small parties and family gatherings.

parrafo_2.es: Atienden consultas de viernes a domingo, de 8:30 AM a 6 PM, y arman cada buffet a la medida del evento: desde ensaladas frescas hasta pastas y platos calientes servidos en línea de buffet.
parrafo_2.en: They take inquiries Friday through Sunday, from 8:30 AM to 6 PM, and build every buffet around the event: from fresh salads to pastas and hot dishes served buffet style.

texto.es: Cuéntanos la fecha de tu boda o evento y cuántos invitados esperas. Atienden de viernes a domingo.
texto.en: Tell us the date of your wedding or event and how many guests you expect. They take calls Friday through Sunday.

texto.es: Platos calientes, ensaladas y acompañamientos a tu gusto, pensados para servirse en buffet.
texto.en: Hot dishes, salads and sides to your taste, built to be served buffet style.

texto.es: Te damos el precio según el número de invitados y el menú elegido, sin letra chica.
texto.en: We give you the price based on your guest count and the menu you choose, no fine print.

texto.es: Llegamos con todo listo y montamos el buffet, para que tus invitados solo se sirvan y disfruten.
texto.en: We arrive with everything ready and set up the buffet, so your guests just serve themselves and enjoy.

nota.es: Cada evento se cotiza según invitados y menú. Escríbenos sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every event is quoted based on guests and menu. Message us, no strings attached.

texto.es: Lo que más nos piden. Catering de boda con buffet casero, bien sazonado y servido con cuidado.
texto.en: What we are asked for the most. Wedding catering with a homemade buffet, well seasoned and served with care.

texto.es: De una fiesta pequeña a una reunión familiar grande, con el mismo cuidado en cada plato.
texto.en: From a small party to a large family gathering, with the same care in every dish.

texto.es: Varias familias repiten con nosotros año tras año para sus celebraciones.
texto.en: Several families come back to us year after year for their celebrations.

texto.es: Ensaladas frescas, pastas y platos calientes montados en línea de buffet, listos para tus invitados.
texto.en: Fresh salads, pastas and hot dishes set up buffet style, ready for your guests.

pie.es: ¿No ves lo que buscas? Escríbenos igual, armamos el menú a tu medida.
pie.en: Do not see what you are looking for? Message us anyway, we will build the menu around you.

items.quote: Lana’s kitchen is absolutely amazing!!!!. The food is really delicious. Everyone loved it and we received many compliments on taste and presentation. The absolute best catering in Jacksonville. Highly recommend it for everyone for a small party, wedding, or any celebration.
Really great food!!!!!! They catered my son’s wedding and everything was as delicious as we had expected. Professional, punctual, honest, and trustworthy people.

Amazing catering! The food at our wedding was absolutely delicious and beautifully presented. Everything was fresh, well-prepared, and our guests loved it. Thank you for helping make our special day even more perfect!

We had a great experience with Lana’s kitchen in several occasions for many years and it was always pleasure to have absolutely delicious food and service! I would recommend her serve 100% and I know you will never regret to choose her!!!
